dom.motifs: A white circular breastplate with a crisp black spiral is the central motif; rounded cobalt-blue shoulder and shin plates echo her spherical silhouette. White full-finger fitted gloves with slim blue cuffs echo Poliwhirl hands. Small rounded blue headband ornaments echo the raised eye forms as abstract costume details, never extra eyes. No tail.
dom.scene: A canal lock maintenance walkway at sunset. She balances in a light forward stepping stance with both relaxed hands away from the torso, face turned toward the camera; swept split panels and compact streamlined propulsion.
